instructions:
Two kinds of items here.
  'finding' items: the model already made this specific claim (shown inline below). Open prompt_file, check the evidence yourself against the real session, and set human_verdict to 'correct' (this really happened), 'incorrect' (it did not — a false positive), or 'unsure' (excluded from scoring).
  'zero_finding_session' items: the model found NOTHING in this session, across every key. Open prompt_file and read it — if you spot something the model should have caught, add an entry to human_missed_findings: {"call_name": "...", "subcategory": "...", "cause_prompt": ..., "note": "..."}. Leave the list empty if the session really is clean; that counts as a confirmed true negative.

key_descriptions.not_enough_verification:not-tested: Agent claims finished but never verified it (no test, no manual check).
key_descriptions.not_enough_verification:self-report: Agent itself says some important part wasn't tested.
key_descriptions.not_enough_verification:ask-for-manual-t: Agent asks the human to test something manually.
key_descriptions.not_enough_verification:repetitive-bug-f: After agent called it done, user tested manually and reported bugs.
key_descriptions.not_enough_specification:no-spec-detecte: User asked for an implementation without a detailed enough spec.
key_descriptions.not_enough_specification:repetitive-requ: Agent fixed it the wrong way, user pushed back, repeatedly.
key_descriptions.not_enough_specification:self-report: Agent itself says it doesn't have enough specification.
key_descriptions.no_visual_reference: User asked for a UI/visual change but gave no image or design file.

evidence.note: The user rejected the implemented circular download indicator as too large and asked for a more refined design.
